goal: Is ke baad aap bata sakein ge ke do matrices ko multiply kiya ja sakta hai ya nahi, jawab ka size nikaal sakein ge, aur woh teen nested loops likh sakein ge jo jawab compute karte hain, us sum ke saath jo har cell ke liye reset hota hai.
warmup: Ek canteen mein 3 cheezein milti hain: samosa, roll aur chai. Do dukaanon par un ke daam alag alag hain, aur Monday aur Tuesday ko aap har cheez alag alag tadaad mein kharidte hain. Har dukaan par har din kitne paise dene hain, yeh janne ke liye aap wahi chota sa kaam baar baar karte hain: ek din ki quantities lein, har ek ko us dukaan ke daam se multiply karein, aur sab ko add kar dein. Matrix multiplication bilkul yehi kaam hai jo har din aur har dukaan ke liye kiya jata hai. Jawab ka ek cell = quantities ki ek row ko daamon ke ek column se multiply karke add karna.
definition: Matrix A ko matrix B se tab hi multiply kiya ja sakta hai jab A ke COLUMNS ki tadaad B ki ROWS ki tadaad ke barabar ho. Agar A ki r1 rows aur c1 columns hain, aur B ki r2 rows aur c2 columns hain, to hamein c1 = r2 chahiye. Jawab wali matrix C ki r1 rows aur c2 columns hongi. Har cell C[i][j] products ka sum hota hai: A ki row i lein, B ka column j lein, jo pairs saamne aate hain unhein multiply karein aur phir add kar dein. Yaad rakhein ke A x B aur B x A ek jaise nahi hote, aur aksar un mein se sirf ek hi mumkin hota hai.
howItWorks: Teen loops use karein. Loop i A ki ek row chunta hai. Loop j B ka ek column chunta hai. i aur j mil kar jawab ka sirf EK cell C[i][j] chunte hain. Us cell ke liye loop k, A ki row i ke saath aur B ke column j mein neeche ki taraf, ek saath chalta hai, is liye A[i][k] aur B[k][j] hamesha ek sahi pair hote hain. k loop ke andar hum A[i][k] * B[k][j] ko sum naam ke variable mein add karte hain. Sab se zaroori line sum = 0 hai jo k loop se PEHLE likhi jati hai: har naya cell zero se ginti shuru karta hai. Agar aap yeh bhool gaye to pichle cell ka total sum ke andar abhi bhi maujood hota hai aur naya jawab zaroorat se bara aata hai. Visual par Play dabayein: dekhein ke A ki row aur B ka column roshan hote hain, phir sum ek ek product ke saath barhta hai. 2x2 matrices ki hath se misaal: A = [1 2; 3 4], B = [5 6; 7 8]. C[0][0] = 1x5 + 2x7 = 19. C[0][1] = 1x6 + 2x8 = 22. C[1][0] = 3x5 + 4x7 = 43. C[1][1] = 3x6 + 4x8 = 50.
